notes.title: Mark of the Deep Now $19.99 – Permanent Price Drop + New Update Live!
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurers,

We’ve got exciting news: Mark of the Deep is now permanently priced at [b]$19.99 USD[/b]!

While game prices across the industry continue to climb, we’re heading in a different direction. This new, lower price reflects our long-term commitment to supporting the game and growing our community of daring explorers.

Alongside the price drop, we’ve shipped a new update focused on quality-of-life improvements and polish, including:
[list]
[*] [b]Full Mouse and Keyboard Remapping Support[/b]: Customize your inputs exactly how you like.
[*] [b]Progression Bug Fixes[/b]: We’ve resolved several blockers to ensure smoother progression.
[*] [b]Performance Optimizations[/b]: The game now runs more reliably across a wider range of hardware.
[*] [b]Miscellaneous Tweaks and Polish[/b]: Small refinements based on your feedback.
[/list]Whether you’ve been waiting to jump in or looking to return, now is a perfect time to explore the depths. If you’ve already purchased Mark of the Deep, thank you. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping the game.

We’ll have more updates to share in the coming months, so stay tuned. In the meantime, feel free to leave a review or join the conversation on the Steam forums.

Thanks for all your support,
The Mad Mimic Team

notes.title: Mark of the Deep – Major Gameplay Update and New Bundle!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers!

Today marks a major update for Mark of the Deep, directly inspired by your invaluable feedback. This update introduces significant gameplay improvements, new mechanics, and quality-of-life enhancements to ensure your adventures feel better than ever.

We're also excited to announce a special collaboration bundle with the acclaimed roguelike Curse of the Dead Gods.

[h3]Update Highlights:[/h3]

[b]Enemy Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Enemy Stagger System:[/b]
Enemies and bosses can now be staggered after consecutive hits, adding depth and strategy to combat. The stagger amount scales with the Rookie’s attacks.
[*] [b]Boss Rebalancing:[/b]
[*] [b]Takon:[/b] Enhanced damage and faster animations make for a more challenging and dynamic encounter.
[*] [b]Nereida:[/b] Completely redesigned fight, tailored for better integration with core gameplay.
[/list]
[b]Rookie Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Roll Mechanics:[/b]
Rookie now moves faster immediately after rolling, and rolls can interrupt basic attacks at any time for increased fluidity.
[*] [b]Adjusted Hookshot:[/b]
A new minimum distance requirement has been added, ensuring strategic positioning is essential.
[/list]
[b]Introducing the In-Game Map[/b]
[list]
[*] A biome-level map is now available, clearly indicating Rookie’s current position and biome names.
[*] It also highlights biomes where Angry Mermaid crew members await rescue, while preserving the sense of exploration by leaving finer details to be discovered.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145687/a7b72fe7c250da27f68741567d02e95c14b4b33a.png[/img]
[h3]Watch the New Gameplay Video[/h3]

Check out our new video showcasing these major enhancements, alongside screenshots of the newly introduced in-game map.

[previewyoutube=WspWdmBx_es;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Bundle: Curse of the Dead Gods X Mark of the Deep[/h3]

We're thrilled to announce a partnership with the hit roguelike, Curse of the Dead Gods! Explore both games in this bundle and experience the best of action-adventure roguelikes.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49584/Curse_of_the_Dead_Gods_X_Mark_of_the_Deep_Bundle/

[h3]Keep the Feedback Coming![/h3]

Your thoughtful reviews and feedback have directly shaped these improvements. Please continue to share your experiences and suggestions, as it helps us immensely in our ongoing development journey.

Thanks for your support, and enjoy the updated adventure!

— The Mad Mimic Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.0.2 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We just released Patch 1.0.0.0.2! We appreciate your support, and every bit of feedback helps us continue refining the game.

Patch Notes:
✅ Fixed an issue where a crash during the Leviathan Cutscene could cause a softlock, preventing gates from reopening. Now, the gates will always open when reloading.
✅ Fixed an issue where keyboard bindings were not saving properly.
✅ Fixed minor localization issues across various languages.
✅ Fixed a bug where a potion appeared in the inventory before the player had acquired one.
✅ Implemented a new font for Traditional and Simplified Chinese for better readability.

[h2][b]We’d Love to Hear From You[/b][/h2]

If you're enjoying Mark of the Deep or have suggestions for improvements, consider leaving an honest review on Steam. Your feedback helps us understand what’s working, what could be better, and what features you’d like to see in future updates.

notes.title: MARK OF THE DEEP LAUNCH DATE POSTPONED
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145687/6505a0e87030abcf1e4dd66c6e6b47a29e4032de.png[/img]

To all the fans and friends of Mark of the Deep,

At Mad Mimic, we’ve always been committed to the highest standards, while also putting our fans first when it comes to making decisions. Because of this, we’ve had to make the difficult choice to postpone the game’s release for a couple of months. The game itself is nearly complete, and we hope you’ve had a chance to try it through the demos and beta builds we’ve released on Steam over the past few months. However, in order to address some of the challenges with porting and ensure the game is incredible on all platforms, we will need a little more time.

That being said, Mark of the Deep will no longer meet its originally planned launch date this week. This was not an easy decision, and we understand the disappointment it may cause.

We don’t want to rely on post-launch patches to improve the game on console platforms, so we firmly believe this extra time will help us deliver the game in its best possible state.

Thank you so much for your patience, understanding, and ongoing support for Mark of the Deep.

Mad Mimic.

The developers of Mark of the Deep are also going to host a [b]live broadcast on February 5th at 5pm (EST) playing the demo[/b], with an open space for questions and doubts about anything related to the game. And if you can't watch the broadcast, don't worry: we're available to chat with you at anytime on our Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/madmimic]https://discord.gg/madmimic[/url]

Finally, check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933370/Mark_of_the_Deep/]Mark of the Deep Steam page[/url] and if you like it please [b]add the game to your Steam wishlist[/b]!
